title: Resume a reloaded walk at the chapter the board shows, not Reset and restart
deviations_from_card: resumePointOf takes the board object {entries, axis} (what getBoard returns) rather than (board, axis); readResume exposes the null reason ('empty' | 'complete'). SimCtx already had resume() (pause/resume), so the new members are `resumable` + `resumeAt()`. Lock rule from the coordinator: `{hold:true, keep:true}` re-takes a LIVE lease only when the caller presents that lease's token (renewSimRun), which the tab keeps in sessionStorage across a reload (storedLease/storeLease/tabStorage in simRunLease.ts); otherwise it is an ordinary beginSimRun claim, refused SIM_RUN_ACTIVE under any other live token. `keep` implies hold. Two walk details the card did not name: entering at Hired asks /api/sim/offer-link first and falls back to the Offer chapter when no offer is open (the board cannot distinguish 'offer sent' from 'offer not drafted' - both are offer column + null approval); entering at Interview after the slot was confirmed skips scheduling. The walk became a chapter table (Record<SimPhaseId, () => StepOpts>) run over chaptersFrom, as the critic advised; this re-indents the step bodies (hence the large whitespace-only diff in useSimulationWalk.ts; --ignore-all-space ~290/36). Moves still go through engine.move(). Two extra pure cases beyond the card (axis-by-role resume, lease storage/claimInit). Series: catalogs, doc, perf raise (each alone under the lock), then ONE feat commit with its tests - a test-only commit would be red. The existing source guard 'the renew never reaches the purge' was re-scoped to end at the new keep branch and still forbids resetSim/beginSimRun in the renew branch.
notes: test:unit exit 1: exactly one BROKEN file, app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts 'an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree' (grandchildren not forked before abort) - untouched by this card, fails the same run alone; environmental (Windows process tree / shared box), not mine. Everything else 10105 pass. test:perf exit 1: after my raise (page 1403/8833 -> 1404/8848, my measured share +1 module / 15201 bytes), page is 8853 KB vs 8848 and the llm-config / job-ingest / 12 api route overages - none of those graphs reach any of my files (checked with walkGraph); siblings have uncommitted app/_lib/db/core.ts, campaign.ts, rediscovery-alert-store.ts. tsc: zero errors outside the untracked kpi-sim/ copy. Not verified in a live browser (no dev server allowed): the coordinator's smoke should start a walk, reload mid-Offer, and check the console shows 'Resume at Offer' with the candidate in the title, that Resume re-enters without a purge, and that a second tab's Resume is refused while the first walks.
